newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong gold ends down on European sales.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong gold ends down on European sales.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold ended down on Tuesday from New York's previous close after a strong bout of afternoon selling from Europe could not be matched by shortcovering, bullion traders said.
Bullion ended at US$342.00/50 an ounce against New York's US$342.70/343.10 close on Monday.
"We saw good selling from German and Swiss customers," said one bullion dealer.
Some sources said the selling was speculative and that gold was trading within a tight range of $341 to $343.
European selling pushed gold down to $341.20/50 where it met shortcovering and bargain-hunting which drove prices back up to closing levels, dealers said.
Physical demand was mediocre, traders said.
Local gold ended HK$7 lower at HK$3,164 a tael.
The carry over charge at the Chinese Gold and Silver
Exchange Society rose to -5.90 from its previous fix at -6.00
